Flow.description: DIR-869: Before-save fast field update - clears RES_Pricing_Stale__c the moment a Quote is genuinely repriced, which hides the pricing-stale warning banner on the Quote page. 2026-08-28 CORRECTION: originally keyed off ISCHANGED(LastPricedDate), but live testing proved LastPricedDate is never actually populated by Reprice All in this org (confirmed via QuoteHistory - it stayed null through a full reprice cycle that did visibly correct TotalPrice). Re-keyed off CalculationStatus instead, confirmed via the same QuoteHistory trace to reliably cycle CompletedWithPricing -> Saving -> CompletedWithPricing exactly when Reprice All runs, and to NOT change at all during the plain rejection-revert DML (6+ minute gap with zero CalculationStatus activity observed between a rejection and the next real reprice in testing). Deliberately a $Record assignment only, no separate Update DML, so it runs inside Reprice All's own save (whatever context invokes it, privileged or not) with zero risk of the CANNOT_EXECUTE_FLOW_TRIGGER block seen elsewhere in this project when a Flow/Apex issues its own separate DML back onto Quote pricing fields - this only ever edits the in-memory record already being saved. Only handles the "user clicked Reprice All" recovery path; the "user entered a new discount instead" path is handled separately in RES_Quote_Line_Item_After_Update_Sync_Header_Discount.
